verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a GPU cloud and ML platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents cron-style or recurring triggers. Workflows are described only as automated ML pipelines, with no schedule, and auto-shutdown is an inactivity-based stop, not a recurring job schedule. Neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
